R285: IN-BATTLE ESCAPE (USER APPROVED 2026-11-18 1:50 PM, all recommendations O1-O8). O1 (Where the button goes): A (recommended): a 4th button in the Battlefield menu (under Isometric / Log / Mission, BattleHUD.lua ~L675–701). It's built with the same shared battle bar button (`Theme.MakeTabButton`) as Move/Skills/Wait (ruling 2026-11-18 10:00 AM). It's out of the way, so it's hard to tap by accident. No new icon art unless the user asks (standing rule). If an icon is wanted, reuse an existing one, e.g. the Back icon. Otherwise the button is text only. O2 (When Escape is allowed): A (recommended): only while a player unit's turn prompt is open (inside `waitForPlayerCommand`). Not while an animation or the enemy's turn plays, and not while a facing, tile, steal or choice picker is open. At other times the button is dimmed. The server checks the same thing. O3 (Confirm popup): Recommended (only option): the shared confirm popup with Back + check. The check uses the destructive red tint (`Theme.DestructiveIconTint`, confirmStyle "Danger", ruling 2026-11-18 10:22 AM). The message shows what escaping costs: kept EXP, half the gold, loot lost, failed quest, and the actual Renown loss. It also shows the "doesn't count as a battle" line when the clock is under 2000 CT, and the fee line if O4-A is chosen. O4 (Escaping right away at the Rank floor (see exploit E1)): A (recommended, payout change, needs the Simulator): an escape under 2000 CT also charges the quest's cancel fee (50% of the posted gold, game_flow 28/35, already shown on the card as "Cancel — {fee} gold"). Escaping straight away then always costs at least as much as cancelling at the board. From 2000 CT on, no fee. O5 (HP/MP of units that escape): A (recommended): follow unit_progression 96 as written. Units that are still up keep their current HP/MP. KO'd units stay KO and become 1 HP at base. No recovery (persistent_hp_mp_rules 5). O6 (Escape inside a dungeon battle): A (recommended): escaping a dungeon battle = the dungeon's early Escape (project_rules 264: "allowed at ANY time"). The run fails and the whole Bag is lost. The party keeps EXP, 75% of the run gold and normal-battle materials. This battle's loot is lost. No Renown (Q5). The confirm popup adds the approved SB-44 line. The 2000 CT rule still decides whether the battle counts toward the 5-battle reset (Q3). O7 (Tavern recruit refresh on an escape that doesn't count): A (recommended): skip it as well. unit_progression 95 says the whole completed-battle increment is skipped, and the tavern refresh is part of `OnBattleCompleted` (GMS:1070–1071). O8 (Test Arena / dev battles): Recommended: no Escape button (the dev Instant Lose already exists). BUILD REQUIREMENTS: (C1) add a separate saved quest-board period counter (e.g. questBoard.period) that moves on every return to base, so an uncounted escape (under 2000 CT) still re-rolls the board without moving the completed-battle count; old saves start at their current value. (C4) Escape uses its own server-checked request (only from the session player, only while the battle runs and a player prompt is open, once per battle) - not the unchecked battle command channel. Save order (proposal section 6): escape flag -> normal defeat path (Renown success=false) -> cancel fee charged on the server BEFORE the save -> save -> battle ended -> completed-battle step gets counted = (not escaped or CT >= 2000). Result screen shows ESCAPED with the same reward lines and the actual Renown loss. TESTER ITEMS (Simulator): (a) the elite result for the next counted battle must not re-roll after an uncounted escape; (b) the fee is charged before the save and gold is clamped at 0 (reuse the board Cancel rule).
